column3: Close to the Hebrew; “until went into exile Jerusalem” is rendered “until the carrying away of Jerusalem captive.”
Close to the Hebrew; “set apart” is rendered “sanctified,” and “appointed” “ordained.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the Lord Yahweh” is rendered “Lord GOD,” and “I do not know [how] to speak” “I cannot speak.”
Close to the Hebrew; “of them” (from before them) is rendered “of their faces.”
Close to the Hebrew; “pluck up” is rendered “root out,” and “tear down” “throw down.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I am watching” (shoqed) is rendered “I am ready,” losing the wordplay with “almond” (shaqed).
Close to the Hebrew; “a pot blown upon” is rendered “a boiling pot.”
Close to the Hebrew; “clans” is rendered “families.”
Close to the Hebrew; “made smoke” is rendered “Burned incense.”
Close to the Hebrew; “gird your loins” is rendered “prepare yourself.”
